title: Paid Antonym - Part (ii) (SSC CGL 2021)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Devious
questions.solution:
D) Devious(adjective) – Showing a skillful use of underhanded tactics to achieve goals, sly, sneaky, dishonest, untrustworthy. चालाक/ छली
Antonym:Sincere(adjective) – Free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings, honest, truthful, straightforward. सच्चा/ ईमानदार

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Sober
questions.solution:
C) Sober(adjective) – Not affected by alcohol; temperate, serious, rational, clear-headed. गंभीर/ सौम्‍य
Antonym:Drunk(adjective) – Affected by alcohol, intoxicated, inebriated. नशे में

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Relay
questions.solution:
D) Relay(verb) - To pass along (information, messages, etc.), to transfer, or to broadcast. पास करना, संचारित करना
Antonym:Hold(verb) - To keep, to retain, to maintain possession, or to not pass on. रखना, बनाए रखना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Authentic
questions.solution:
A) Authentic(adjective) – Genuine, original, real, not copied or false. वास्तविक, असली
Antonym:Incredible(adjective) – Impossible or difficult to believe, extraordinary. अविश्वसनीय

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Spacious
questions.solution:
A) Spacious(adjective) – Having ample space, roomy, capacious, expansive. विशाल
Antonym:Cramped(adjective) – Limited in space, tight, constricted, restricted. संकुचित

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Altercation
questions.solution:
A) Altercation(noun) – A heated or angry dispute; an argument or controversy, a noisy argument or disagreement. तकरार/ अनबन
Antonym:Agreement(noun) – Harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling; a position or result of agreeing.समझौता

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Taut
questions.solution:
D) Taut(adjective) – Stretched or pulled tight; not slack. कसा हुआ
Antonym:Slack(adjective) – Not taut or held tightly in position; loose. ढीला

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Constrict
questions.solution:
C) Constrict(verb) – To draw together or become narrower, to tighten, to make something become tighter or narrower. कसना
Antonym:Stretch(verb) – To extend to full length, to spread out, to make something wider or longer, especially by pulling it. फैलाना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Feeble
questions.solution:
C) Feeble(adjective) – Lacking physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness, weak, frail, delicate. कमज़ोर
Antonym:Strong(adjective) – Having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks, powerful, robust, sturdy. मजबूत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Famished
questions.solution:
D) Famished(adjective) – This word describes an extreme state of hunger or the need for food. It conveys a sense of urgency and an intense craving to eat. बहुत भूखा
Antonym:Satiated(adjective) – Satisfied to the full, having appetite or desire fully gratified, no longer feeling hunger. तृप्त

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Pliable
questions.solution:
D) Pliable(adjective) – Easily bent, flexible, supple, malleable, adaptable. लचीला
Antonym:Rigid(adjective) – Unable to bend or be forced out of shape; not flexible, stiff, hard. कठोर

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Brittle
questions.solution:
C) Brittle(adjective) – Easily broken, fragile, delicate, frangible. कमजोर
Antonym:Durable(adjective) – Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing, robust, sturdy. मजबूत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
PRIMARY
questions.solution:
A) PRIMARY(adjective) - Main, most important, basic, fundamental. प्राथमिक
Antonym: Secondary(adjective) – Less important than primary, not primary, subsidiary, ancillary. द्वितीयक

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Multiple
questions.solution:
C) Multiple(adjective) – Having or involving several parts, elements, or members, various, numerous. बहुसंख्यक
Antonym:Single(adjective) – Only one; not one of several. एकमात्र

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Obdurate
questions.solution:
C) Obdurate(adjective) – Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action, unyielding, inflexible, rigid. कठोर/ ज़िद्दी
Antonym:Amenable(adjective) – Open and responsive to suggestion; easily persuaded or controlled, agreeable, compliant. आज्ञाकारी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
GRACEFUL
questions.solution:
A) Graceful(adjective) – Characterized by elegance or beauty of form, manner, movement, or speech; elegant. सुंदर
Antonym:Awkward(adjective) – Lacking grace or ease in movement or manner; clumsy. अनाड़ी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Frenzy
questions.solution:
C) Frenzy(noun) – A state or period of uncontrolled excitement or wild behavior, hysteria, madness. उन्माद/ पागलपन
Antonym:Calm(noun) – A state of tranquility, stillness, peace, composed, serene. शांत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Proclaim
questions.solution:
C)Proclaim(verb) – To announce something publicly or officially, especially something positive. घोषित करना
Antonym:Conceal(verb) – To keep something secret or to prevent it from being known, to hide. छिपाना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Refined
questions.solution:
B) Refined(adjective) – Elegant and cultured in appearance, manner, or taste, developed, polished. सुसंस्कृत
Antonym:Crude(adjective) – In a natural or raw state; not yet processed or refined, basic, unrefined. अपरिष्कृत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Industrious
questions.solution:
D) Industrious(adjective) – Hardworking, diligent, active, busy. संघर्षशील
Antonym:Indolent(adjective) – Wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy, idle. आलसी
